name: StackedBar
summary: Parts of a whole by status, in one bar: inner segments are square so small parts stay legible; only the outer ends of the whole bar are rounded. Status colours only: categorical series arrive with the first chart, from the spectrum. Not for progress over time (use Progress) or for comparing values that aren't parts of one whole.
a11y: `role="img"`, named by the label and every part with its share in order, so the colours are never the only carrier of meaning. Show the same numbers as text nearby when people need to read them.

props.name: label
props.description: What the whole is, e.g. "Checks". Read before the parts.

props.name: label

props.name: share
props.description: Its share of the whole, 0 to 100. Shares should add up to 100.
